rule:
p runs over the primes >= 2^(T*R) (T*R >= 16) with 2^T | p-1, in increasing order; a prime is ELIGIBLE iff it is not a Fermat prime (p-1 not a power of two), a prime-order curve y^2=x^3+ax+b is found within 400 attempts, and a base with B_real >= ceil(B/2) exists under the g rule; the first eligible prime is used and every rejected prime is recorded. Curve search: StdRng (rand 0.8, ChaCha12) seeded by SHA-256('pkm.m8-panel/v1|curve|||

'), a, b uniform in [1,p), skip singular, #E counted natively (exhaustive Legendre sum for p < 2^20, else Hasse-interval baby-step giant-step of a random point whose unique candidate is #E), first prime #E; r*Pv = O is checked for a random point. zeta = h^((p-1)>>T) for the least h >= 2 with zeta^(2^(T-1)) != 1. g rule: the least integer g in [2, 20000) outside mu_(2^T) (g^(2^T) != 1) with B_real >= ceil(2^T/2). V = { g*zeta^k }. Real base = { x in V : x^3+ax+b is a non-zero square }, positive sign = the point with y <= (p-1)/2. Generator P = point with the least x >= 1, y <= (p-1)/2. Exception: T=3, R=8 reuses the L1 decisive cell (p=16801793; a, b, g reconstructed by a native port of CPython random.Random(str) following gen.py, no eligibility rule applied; see l1_reuse).

tool.git_note: null when run outside a git checkout and PKM_PRESENT_GIT_COMMIT was not set at build
tool.name: pkm_present_panel

wrapper_rule: derive_from(t, ratio, seed, no_l1_reuse = true, min_prime = prime); --prime P pins the prime (error if the eligibility rule steps off P); --require-breal N steps to the next eligible prime while B_real < N (each rejection recorded; error with --prime); --slug NAME replaces the cell slug that seeds the targets/planted RNG streams (derivation_slug keeps the one that seeded the curve); --nested-ts reuses p, a, b, r, g, generator at smaller t with zeta_t' = zeta_t^(2^(t-t')) and slug <slug>-nested-t<t'>
